runtime_ledger_partitions.description: Runtime ledger_events range partitions inherit parent columns/content; detached archives retain copies.

runtime_collection_partitions.description: Runtime collection_chunks partitions and GIN/HNSW indexes inherit parent content/cleanup policy.

source_objects.description: Logical-path source bytes in Azure/S3/GCS/file/memory, including separately retained object versions/replicas.

evidence_objects.description: Sealed typed result bytes in reserved evidence paths through SourceStore, including pg fallback.

datastore_manifest.description: Canonical manifest.json with component metadata, counts, engines and content-derived diagnostic probe queries.

datastore_archive.description: L2 archives/components and build-spec/plan sidecars retain source paths, citation text, lexemes, vectors and indexes.

l0_handles.description: Process-local open shards/readers and memory-mapped records/lexical/vector data; eviction does not delete L2.

l1_hydrated_files.description: Local hydrated artifacts, quarantine/residue and staging retain text/embeddings separately from eligibility.

build_staging.description: Attempt directories, extracted chunks, embeddings and index work files before sealing; failed-attempt cleanup is not all-residue erasure.

vocabulary_generation.description: Sampled document text/provider prompts/completions and derived term groups; persisted vocabulary and provider copies are independent.

checked_answers.description: Validated completion/quotes/source/evidence data returned to callers; no dedicated Server checked-answer persistence cache.

exports_downloads.description: Original/evidence downloads, authoring YAML/ZIP, audit/report JSON/CSV and caller response caches leave Server control.

index_exports.description: PG export streams into mirror/rebuild artifacts include selected text, source metadata and embeddings.

database_backups.description: PostgreSQL base backups/dumps/WAL and detached partition archives contain all SQL surfaces and pg source bytes.

object_backups.description: Object versions/soft delete, filesystem snapshots and source/evidence/datastore backups are independent of DB restore.

provider_copies.description: Submitted source samples, prompts, embeddings input, answer context and completions; provider retention/logs need separate policy.

operational_logs.description: Operator diagnostic sinks may contain errors/identifiers; do not presume logs are content-free or erased with SQL.

memory_backend.description: In-process ledger/source/evidence/configuration/idempotency/budget maps and transient audit channel; persistent sessions require PostgreSQL. With no pool the audit writer drops records after debug logging. Process exit does not erase host snapshots/dumps.
